Club committee and helpers

The club committee are: Tom McNeeney, Spyros Roumeliotis, Tamsin O’Connell, Irene Yue Ling Yeung, Ping Lian, Bruno Poltronieri, Peter Rootham-Smith, and Svetlana Stoyanchev.

The club is very grateful to all the others who help organise the club, including Paul, Michael, Nikoleta, Aisha, Samaya, Vicki and James; as well as parents who have helped on the club front desk including Dan, Louise, Liudmila and Helena.

We are entirely run by volunteers (including parents) and we really welcome help to make the club run as smoothly as possible. That includes parents helping out on the desk at the start of sessions, and helping to put tables out at the start and clearing away at the end.

If you would like any more information or have suggestions please email us (cambridgechessgo at gmail dot com).
